changelog:
Video Calls, Bluetooth Alerts & Mod Platform.

Video Calls: Ava intercom now streams live video during voice calls. Front camera sends low-bandwidth video (~480p, 8fps) over LAN — no internet, no cloud. Tap screen for controls. Audio stays Opus, video is separate lightweight track. Check kids from kitchen to bedroom, see who's at front door, elderly check-in without extra apps. Path: Settings → Extensions → Voice Messages.

Bluetooth Presence Alerts: Track BLE beacons with custom alert sounds, per-device RSSI threshold and away delay. Alert on near or out of range. High-resolution 6-second sampling (30s on low-end chips). On-device alert + HA binary sensor. Track backpack, child wristband, elderly care devices. Path: Settings → Bluetooth → bell icon on tracked device. Thanks @AJolly for inspiration.

Voice Replies Restructured: All reply settings consolidated under Voice Config → Voice Replies. Standard TTS vs Streaming TTS switch — Standard for reliability with subtitles, Streaming for faster first response. Whisper Response auto-lowers playback volume in quiet rooms. Continuous Conversation moved here with two end conditions: exit keyword or question mark. 

Mod Extension Platform: Runtime-loadable Java modules extend hardware without APK modification. Add LED rings, screen control, GPIO, new HA entities, hook voice pipeline events (14 events via onVoicePipelineEvent), intercept hardware buttons. Headless config via ACTION_APPLY_SETTINGS JSON patches. Full guide: github.com/knoop7/ava-mods. Addresses #90.

Fixes: HA port randomization persistence #peter Meiser, voice config UI clarity, voiceprint accuracy improvements, dark mode screen-off, Bluetooth small-screen layout, device deletion confirmation, Gecko engine crash recovery with death monitor, various stability and UI polish.
